name: @red-cup-engineering/semantic-candidate-review-service
description: Behavioral-assay acceptance and bounded semantic advisory for software candidates.

scripts.check: node --check src/review.mjs && node --check src/market-dispatch.mjs && node --check src/protocol.mjs && node --check src/client.mjs && node --check src/law.mjs && node --check bin/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check bin/server.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one canonical RMN review request naming bounded changed source, exact acceptance vectors, and an optional protected executable assay capsule
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: missing protected executable assay evidence, unbounded source, provider selection by the customer, noncanonical carrier, or provider assertion of customer acceptance
